setup.text: Soft earth yields beneath the sun, tilled recently to prepare for the festival planting. The farmer presses sticks and dirt into the soil and draws a line.

option_a.text: The player asks, "Does the ground matter?" The farmer wipes sweat from his brow. "Has to be turned first. Packed ground just scuffs."

option_b.text: The player turns a second patch of soil with a hoe before offering it. The farmer nods approvingly as a clean furrow opens across the earth.

option_c.text: The player tries the cast on the cobblestones instead. The stone remains solid and unyielding.
